# netactuate_magic_mesh (Resource)

Manages a Magic Mesh.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_magic_mesh" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for the magic mesh.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description for the magic mesh.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mesh_id` (Number) The ID of the magic mesh.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_magic_mesh.example 12345
```
